rows.grounds: instrumental plural of tilataṇḍulaka; sesame-rice offering
past passive participle from vac; declared
compound dravya plus anudīraṇa; locative singular

items.question: What alternative offering substance is prescribed for the rite when substances are mentioned?
items.inference: The verse permits sesame-rice as an alternative offering substance.
uncertainties: exact scope of dravyānudīraṇe remains unclear
items.plain_english: Or even with sesame-rice, as stated in the mention of substances.
